article_content: 'Following a 2012 divorce, prominent New York real estate broker Carol E. Levy, known as 'The Billion Dollar Broker,' finds herself in an unusual living situation. Due to a legal ruling mandating spousal support for her ex-husband, Chris Lipman, they continue to share a luxurious duplex at the Beresford on Central Park West.  Levy has since remarried Joel Goron and the couple share the master suite with their newborn and Levy's two teenage daughters from her previous marriage.  Meanwhile, Lipman resides rent-free in a guest bedroom on a lower floor. The apartment, boasting city views and opulent features, is listed for $18 million, down from its initial $24 million asking price, with Lipman entitled to 45% of the sale. Levy and Goron express their resolve to move forward with their lives despite this unconventional arrangement, while Lipman states his continued presence is due to both financial considerations and his desire to remain close to his daughters. This situation underscores the challenges many divorced couples face in NYC's competitive real estate market.'
translated_content: 'Bayan rabuwar aure a shekarar 2012, Carol E. Levy, dillaliyar gidaje ta New York da aka fi sani da 'Dillaliyar Dalar Biliyan Daya,' ta tsinci kanta a cikin wani yanayi na musamman na zama. Saboda umarnin kotu da ya ba wa tsohon mijinta, Chris Lipman, tallafin aure, har yanzu suna ci gaba da zama a wani katafaren gida mai hawa biyu a Beresford da ke Central Park West. Levy ta sake yin aure da Joel Goron kuma ma'auratan suna raba babban ɗakin kwana tare da jaririnsu da 'ya'yan Levy mata biyu matasa daga aurenta na baya. A halin yanzu, Lipman yana zaune kyauta a ɗakin baƙi a ƙananan bene. An sanya gidan, wanda ke da kyawawan gannai na birni da fasaloli masu kyau, akan dala miliyan 18, ƙasa da farashin neman dala miliyan 24 na farko, tare da Lipman yana da haƙƙin 45% na tallace-tallace. Levy da Goron sun nuna ƙudurinsu na ci gaba da rayuwarsu duk da wannan tsari na musamman, yayin da Lipman ya bayyana cewa ci gaba da kasancewarsa ya faru ne saboda la'akari na kuɗi da kuma sha'awarsa ta kasancewa kusa da 'ya'yansa mata. Wannan yanayin ya nuna ƙalubalen da yawancin ma'aurata da suka sake aure ke fuskanta a kasuwar gidaje mai tsada ta NYC.'

article_content: 'Hong Kong (CNN) -- Affluent families across Asia are increasingly enrolling their children in elite Western-style schools opening campuses within the region.  Harrow, Winston Churchill's alma mater, recently opened a Hong Kong campus for 750 students, adding to its existing locations in Bangkok and Beijing. Marlborough College, whose alumni includes Kate Middleton, also launched a campus in Malaysia. Other prestigious institutions expanding into Asia include Wellington College and Dulwich College in China, Branksome Hall and Dwight School in South Korea, Epsom College in Malaysia, and Haileybury in Kazakhstan.  According to ISC Research, the international school market is booming, with local students now comprising approximately 80% of enrollment, a significant increase from 20% three decades ago.  'International schools are now big business,' says ISC Research Managing Director Nicholas Brummitt, noting the rise of for-profit institutions. Asia leads the market with 53% of all international schools globally.  'The market's current value, based on fees, is £18.9 billion ($30 billion), projected to rise to £30 billion within 10 years,' Brummitt added.  Governments in Malaysia, Thailand, and South Korea are actively promoting their countries as education hubs. Bob Pick, Master of Marlborough College Malaysia, highlights the school's 'holistic approach,' emphasizing arts, sports, environmental awareness, social responsibility, and moral values.  Despite high fees and long waiting lists, demand remains strong. Annual fees at Harrow International School in Hong Kong can reach HK$160,000 ($21,000), plus a debenture ranging from HK$600,000 ($77,000) to HK$3 million ($385,000).  The increasing demand and influx of expatriates have led to a shortage of international school places in Hong Kong.  While the Hong Kong government provided Harrow with a substantial interest-free loan, critics argue that more support should be directed to local schools.'
translated_content: 'Hong Kong (CNN) -- Iyalai masu kuɗi a duk faɗin Asiya suna ƙara yawan yin rajistar yaransu a manyan makarantun Yammacin Turai waɗanda ke buɗe cibiyoyi a cikin yankin. Harrow, tsohuwar makarantar Winston Churchill, kwanan nan ta buɗe wani reshe a Hong Kong don ɗalibai 750, ƙari ga cibiyoyin da ke akwai a Bangkok da Beijing. Kwalejin Marlborough, wacce ta ƙunshi Kate Middleton a cikin tsofaffin ɗalibanta, ita ma ta ƙaddamar da wani reshe a Malaysia. Wasu sanannun cibiyoyi da ke faɗaɗa zuwa Asiya sun haɗa da Kwalejin Wellington da Kwalejin Dulwich a China, Branksome Hall da Dwight School a Koriya ta Kudu, Kwalejin Epsom a Malaysia, da Haileybury a Kazakhstan. A cewar ISC Research, kasuwar makarantun ƙasa da ƙasa tana bunƙasa, tare da ɗaliban ƙasashen waje waɗanda suka kai kusan kashi 80% na rajista, ƙaruwa mai yawa daga kashi 20% shekaru talatin da suka gabata. 'Makarantun ƙasa da ƙasa yanzu manyan kasuwanci ne,' in ji Daraktan Manajan Binciken ISC Nicholas Brummitt, yana mai lura da haɓakar cibiyoyi masu riba. Asiya ke kan gaba a kasuwa da kashi 53% na dukkan makarantun ƙasa da ƙasa a duniya. 'Darajar kasuwar a yanzu, bisa ga kuɗin makaranta, shine £ 18.9 biliyan ($ 30 biliyan), wanda ake hasashen zai tashi zuwa £ 30 biliyan cikin shekaru 10,' in ji Brummitt. Gwamnatoci a Malaysia, Thailand, da Koriya ta Kudu suna ƙarfafa ƙasashen su a matsayin cibiyoyin ilimi. Bob Pick, Shugaban Kwalejin Marlborough ta Malaysia, ya nuna 'tsarin holistic' na makarantar, yana mai jaddada fasaha, wasanni, wayar da kan muhalli, alhakin zamantakewa, da ɗabi'u. Duk da tsadar kuɗin makaranta da dogayen layukan jira, buƙatar ta ci gaba da ƙarfi. Kuɗin shekara-shekara a Makarantar Harrow ta Duniya da ke Hong Kong na iya kaiwa HK $ 160,000 ($ 21,000), ƙari ga kuɗin shiga daga HK $ 600,000 ($ 77,000) zuwa HK $ 3 miliyan ($ 385,000). Ƙaruwar buƙatu da kwararar baƙi sun haifar da ƙarancin guraben karatu a makarantun ƙasa da ƙasa a Hong Kong. Duk da cewa gwamnatin Hong Kong ta ba wa Harrow gagarumin rancen ba tare da riba ba, masu suka sun yi jayayya cewa ya kamata a ba da ƙarin tallafi ga makarantun gida.'

article_content: 'David Cameron has issued a stark warning about the euro's potential failure amid growing fears of a Greek exit from the single currency.  Dismissing new French President Francois Hollande's assertion that Britain is 'indifferent' to the eurozone's fate, Cameron insisted on its vital importance to the UK economy.  'We want the euro area to succeed,' Cameron stated in an interview with the Daily Mail. 'It represents 40% of our exports. It's crucial these economies return to growth.'  However, Cameron reiterated Britain's differing perspective on the euro. 'We didn't join,' he explained. 'We believe single currencies require unified governments for proper function.'  Acknowledging the eurozone's significant transition, Cameron suggested greater economic and debt policy coordination as essential for its success. 'There's no global example of a single currency without a more unified government,' he observed.  Market instability followed doubts about Franco-German relations after Hollande's victory over Nicolas Sarkozy.  An impending EU summit will address Hollande's proposal to revise the EU fiscal pact, prioritizing growth over austerity.  Meanwhile, political turmoil grips Athens.  Following election losses for Greece's main parties, the far-left Syriza group is attempting to form a government.  Two-thirds of Greek voters supported parties rejecting Brussels-imposed austerity measures.  Failure to reach a deal within three days will trigger new elections.  Cameron hinted at Greece potentially abandoning the euro and reinstating the drachma to regain control over interest rates and currency devaluation.  'All countries must make their own choices,' he stated. 'We chose to stay out. I've always believed different countries require different economic policies.'  Cameron emphasized Britain's ability to tailor its policies to its own needs, citing low interest rates and a competitive currency. 'We have made our choice,' he declared.  'We want European cooperation and a thriving single market, but we don't want the euro. We've shown it's possible to lead in some areas, like the single market and NATO, without participating in others.'
translated_content: 'David Cameron ya yi gargadin cewa kudin Tarayyar Turai na fuskantar barazanar rushewa yayin da ake fargabar cewa Girka za ta fice daga kudin bai daya. Cameron ya yi watsi da ikirarin sabon shugaban Faransa Francois Hollande cewa Birtaniya ba ta damu da makomar Tarayyar Turai ba, yana mai jaddada muhimmancin tattalin arzikin Birtaniya ga tattalin arzikin nahiyar. ''Muna son yankin Tarayyar Turai ya yi nasara,' in ji Cameron a wata hira da Daily Mail. ''Yana wakiltar kashi 40% na kayayyakin da muke fitarwa. Yana da matukar muhimmanci wadannan tattalin arziki su dawo kan ci gaba.'' Duk da haka, Cameron ya sake nanata ra'ayin Birtaniya daban-daban game da Tarayyar Turai. ''Ba mu shiga ba,' ya bayyana. ''Mun yi imanin cewa kudaden bai daya suna bukatar gwamnatoci masu hadin kai don aiki yadda ya kamata.'' Da yake amincewa da babban sauyin da Tarayyar Turai ke yi, Cameron ya ba da shawarar kara hada manufofin tattalin arziki da bashi a matsayin muhimmiyar nasara. ''Babu wani misali a duniya na kudin bai daya ba tare da gwamnati mai hadin kai ba,' in ji shi. Rashin kwanciyar hankali na kasuwa ya biyo bayan shakku game da dangantakar Faransa da Jamus bayan nasarar Hollande akan Nicolas Sarkozy. Wani taron EU da ke tafe zai magance shawarar Hollande ta sake duba yarjejeniyar kasafin kudi ta EU, tare da fifita ci gaba akan matakan tsantseni. A halin yanzu, rikicin siyasa ya dabaibaye birnin Athens. Bayan rashin nasarar da manyan jam'iyyun siyasa biyu suka yi a Girka, kungiyar Syriza mai tsattsauran ra'ayi na hagu na kokarin kafa gwamnati. Kashi biyu bisa uku na masu kada kuri'a a Girka sun goyi bayan jam'iyyun da suka ki amincewa da matakan tsantseni da Brussels ta kakaba. Rashin cimma matsaya cikin kwanaki uku zai haifar da sabon zabe.  Cameron ya yi nuni da cewa Girka na iya barin Tarayyar Turai da dawo da drachma don sake samun iko kan yawan riba da rage darajar kudin. ''Dukkan kasashe dole ne su yanke shawarar kansu,' in ji shi. ''Mun zabi kada mu shiga. Kullum ina imanin cewa kasashe daban-daban suna bukatar manufofin tattalin arziki daban-daban.'' Cameron ya jaddada ikon Birtaniya na daidaita manufofinta da bukatunta, yana mai ambaton karancin riba da kudin da ke da karfin gasa. ''Mun yanke shawararmu,' in ji shi. ''Muna son hadin gwiwar Turai da kasuwar bai daya mai bunkasa, amma ba ma son Tarayyar Turai. Mun nuna cewa yana yiwuwa a jagoranci wasu fannoni, kamar kasuwar bai daya da NATO, ba tare da shiga wasu ba.''

article_content: 'Warehouse worker Craig Birchall, 25, from Scunthorpe, has landed a record-breaking three-spined stickleback. This impressive tiddler, weighing 12 grams and stretching 2.9 inches, surpasses the previous British record, which Birchall also held. While many anglers focus on larger species, Birchall champions the smaller ones. He caught the stickleback using a tiny hook and worm in a local lake. After an hour and numerous smaller catches, he landed the record-breaker. This catch outweighs his previous record from last year by three grams and significantly beats the official record from 1998 held by Dennis Flack. Witnessing the catch was Birchall's mother, who documented it before the fish was safely returned to the water. Birchall plans to officially verify his record with the British Record Fish Committee. Committee chairman, Mike Heylin, praised the size of the catch, calling it 'the biggest, smallest fish.'
translated_content: 'Wani ma’aikacin rumbun ajiya mai suna Craig Birchall, ɗan shekara 25 daga Scunthorpe, ya kama wani ƙaramin kifi mai suna ‘three-spined stickleback’ wanda ya karya tarihin da aka taɓa yi. Wannan ƙaramin kifin mai ban mamaki, mai nauyin gram 12 da tsawon inci 2.9, ya wuce tarihin da Birchall ya riga ya kafa a Birtaniya. Yayin da masunta da yawa ke mai da hankali kan manyan kifaye, Birchall ya fi son ƙanana. Ya kama kifin ne ta amfani da ƙaramin ƙugiya da tsutsotsi a wani tafki da ke kusa da gidansa. Bayan awa ɗaya da kama ƙananan kifaye da yawa, sai ya kama wanda ya karya tarihin. Wannan kamun ya fi wanda ya yi a bara da gram uku, kuma ya fi wanda Dennis Flack ya yi a shekarar 1998. Mahaifiyar Birchall ta shaida kamun, wadda ta ɗauki hotonsa kafin a mayar da kifin cikin ruwa lafiya. Birchall yana shirin tabbatar da tarihin nasa ga Kwamitin Rikodi na Kifaye na Burtaniya. Shugaban kwamitin, Mike Heylin, ya yaba da girman kifin, yana kiransa ‘babban ƙaramin kifi’.'

translated_post: 'Wani ƙaramin kifi, babban tarihi! 🎣 Craig Birchall ya kama wani babban ƙaramin kifi!  🐟 #kamunkifi #tarihi #ƙaraminjarumi'

article_content: 'Patricia McCormick, a pioneering figure in bullfighting, passed away at the age of 83.  As the first American woman to achieve professional status in Mexico, her career spanned a decade, from 1951 to 1962.  McCormick's talent and bravery were undeniable, earning her recognition throughout Mexico and South America. Even competitors acknowledged her potential to surpass them if not for gender barriers.  Despite drawing large crowds and receiving acclaim, she was hindered by discrimination, remaining an apprentice fighter due to lack of male sponsorship.  This injustice didn't deter her spirit; McCormick insisted on facing large bulls on foot, a practice that led to injuries, including a near-fatal goring in 1954. Her passion for bullfighting ignited during a childhood trip to Mexico City, later leading her to drop out of college to pursue her dream.  After retiring, she moved to California, aspiring to be an artist while working as a secretary. Later, facing financial hardship in Texas, she received assistance from a former fan. McCormick was honored in 2006 by Ciudad Acuña and in 2007 by the Heritage Museum of Big Spring.  She died in a nursing home in Del Rio, Texas, without ever marrying or having children.'
translated_content: 'Patricia McCormick, jaruma a fagen nuna ƙarfin hali da dabba, ta rasu tana da shekaru 83. A matsayinta na mace ƴar Amurka ta farko da ta zama ƙwararriya a Mexico, aikinta ya shafe shekaru goma, daga 1951 zuwa 1962. Baiwar McCormick da ƙarfin halinta ba su misaltuwa ba ne, wanda hakan ya sa ta shahara a duk faɗin Mexico da Kudancin Amurka. Har ma masu fafatawa sun amince da ƙarfinta na fin ƙarfinsu idan ba don shingen jinsi ba. Duk da cewa ta jawo hankalin jama'a da yawa kuma ta sami yabo, an hana ta ci gaba saboda nuna bambanci, inda ta kasance ƴar dambe saboda rashin tallafin maza. Wannan rashin adalcin bai hana ta ƙarfin gwiwa ba; McCormick ta dage kan fuskantar manyan bijimai a ƙafa, wani aiki da ya haifar da raunuka, gami da kusan mutuwa a 1954. Sha'awarta ga nuna ƙarfin hali da dabba ta tashi ne a lokacin tafiyar yarinta zuwa Mexico City, daga baya hakan ya sa ta bar makaranta don cimma burinta. Bayan ta yi ritaya, ta koma California, tana son zama mai zane yayin da take aiki a matsayin sakatariya. Daga baya, tana fuskantar matsalolin kuɗi a Texas, ta sami taimako daga wani tsohon mai sha'awarta. An karrama McCormick a shekarar 2006 daga Ciudad Acuña sannan a 2007 daga Gidan Tarihi na Big Spring. Ta mutu a gidan jinya a Del Rio, Texas, ba tare da ta taɓa aure ko haihuwa ba.'
post_content: 'RIP Patricia McCormick, a true trailblazer in bullfighting.  First American woman pro in Mexico, she fought bravely against the odds and gender barriers. #Bullfighting #WomenInSports #RIP #PatriciaMcCormick'

article_content: 'Following the passing of Clive Thatcher at Bristol Royal Infirmary on February 24th, his family discovered his wedding ring missing.  His daughters had previously been unable to remove the ring due to swelling in his hands.  When the undertaker retrieved Mr. Thatcher's body, the ring was gone.  The family also noted approximately £5 missing from his bedside locker.  Mr. Thatcher's daughter, Gloria Bond, expressed the family's shock and sadness.  Her husband, Gerald, emphasized their distress, not over the ring's monetary value, but over the nature of the incident. Avon and Somerset Police are investigating, and the hospital trust has expressed apologies and commitment to a thorough investigation.'
translated_content: 'Bayan rasuwar Clive Thatcher a Asibitin Bristol Royal a ranar 24 ga Fabrairu, iyalansa sun gano cewa an sace zoben aurensa. 'Ya'yansa mata sun kasa cire masa zoben a baya saboda kumburi a hannunsa. Lokacin da mai shirya jana'izar ya dauki gawar Mr. Thatcher, zoben ya bace. Iyalan sun kuma lura da bacewar kudi kusan £5 daga cikin akwatin da ke kusa da gadon asibiti. 'Yar Mr. Thatcher, Gloria Bond, ta bayyana alhini da bakin cikin iyalan. Mijinta, Gerald, ya jaddada bakin cikinsu, ba wai don darajar zoben ba, amma don yanayin da lamarin ya faru. Jami'an 'yan sanda na Avon da Somerset suna gudanar da bincike, kuma hukumar asibiti ta bayyana bakin ciki tare da alkawarin gudanar da cikakken bincike.'
post_content: 'Shocking! A grieving family's pain amplified after their father's wedding ring goes missing from his body at a Bristol hospital.  Police are investigating. #HospitalTheft #Grief #Justice'

article_content: 'Pliny Fisk III, an Austin-based architect, is pioneering sustainable building solutions.  Often called a 'visionary,' Fisk's work centers around utilizing recycled and locally sourced materials.  His latest innovation, 'megacrete,' a cement made from magnesium oxide, phosphate, and brine (a byproduct of petroleum and water treatment), aims to revolutionize building construction.  Fisk's non-profit, the Center for Maximum Potential Building (CMPB), and his teaching position at Texas A&M University, allow him to explore and test these ideas with interns from across the globe. His philosophy promotes adapting to nature's patterns and creating carbon-neutral structures.  Fisk and his wife, Gail Vittori, CMPB co-director and U.S. Green Business Council board member, live a sustainable lifestyle, exemplifying the principles they advocate.'
translated_content: 'Pliny Fisk III, wani mai zane-zane a Austin, yana jagorantar hanyoyin gina gidaje masu dorewa. Sau da yawa ana kiransa 'mai hangen nesa,' aikin Fisk ya ta'allaka ne akan amfani da kayan da aka sake yin amfani da su da kuma na gida.  Sabuwar kirkirar sa, 'megacrete,' wani siminti da aka yi daga magnesium oxide, phosphate, da brine (wani samfuri na man fetur da wuraren kula da ruwa), yana nufin kawo sauyi a ginin gine-gine. Cibiyar Fisk mai zaman kanta, Cibiyar Gina Gine-gine Mai Mafi Girman Iko (CMPB), da kuma matsayin koyarwarsa a Jami'ar Texas A&M, sun ba shi damar bincika da gwada waɗannan ra'ayoyin tare da ƴan makaranta daga ko'ina cikin duniya. Falsafarsa tana inganta daidaitawa da yanayin yanayi da ƙirƙirar gine-gine marasa gurɓataccen yanayi. Fisk da matarsa, Gail Vittori, darektan CMPB kuma memba na kwamitin gudanarwa na Majalisar Kasuwancin Kore ta Amurka, suna rayuwa mai dorewa, suna misalta ƙa'idodin da suke karewa.'
post_content: 'Building a greener future! Architect Pliny Fisk is revolutionizing construction with his eco-friendly 'megacrete.' #sustainablebuilding #greenarchitecture #innovation'

article_content: 'Prior to last Sunday's Canadian Grand Prix, the public tension between Mercedes teammates Lewis Hamilton and Nico Rosberg seemed to have eased.  The Formula One drivers had clashed earlier in the season, notably at the Monaco Grand Prix. However, a playful moment in Montreal, where Hamilton photobombed Rosberg's picture with fans, hinted at improved relations.  Mercedes even shared the amusing photo on social media.  The Monaco Grand Prix saw Hamilton express frustration over Rosberg's qualifying lap incident, which he implied was deliberate, affecting his own performance.  This followed an earlier incident where Rosberg, according to him accidentally, compromised Hamilton's qualifying attempt. While their past friendship was tested by their championship rivalry, there were signs of reconciliation in Canada.  Unfortunately, Hamilton had to retire from the race due to a brake failure, while Rosberg secured a second-place finish.'
translated_content: 'Kafin babban tseren Grand Prix na Kanada na ranar Lahadi da ta gabata, takaddamar da ke tsakanin abokan wasan Mercedes Lewis Hamilton da Nico Rosberg ta yi kama da ta lafa. Direbobin Formula Ɗaya sun yi karo da juna a baya a wannan kakar wasa, musamman a babban tseren Grand Prix na Monaco. Duk da haka, wani lokaci mai ban dariya a Montreal, inda Hamilton ya ɓata hoton Rosberg da magoya baya, ya nuna alamun inganta dangantaka. Mercedes ma ta raba hoton mai ban dariya a shafukan sada zumunta. Babban tseren Grand Prix na Monaco ya ga Hamilton ya nuna bacin rai game da abin da ya faru a zagayen neman gurbi na Rosberg, wanda ya nuna cewa an yi da gangan ne, wanda hakan ya shafi aikinsa. Wannan ya biyo bayan wani lamari da ya faru a baya inda Rosberg, a cewarsa ba da gangan ba, ya kawo cikas ga yunkurin Hamilton na neman gurbi. Duk da cewa abotar da suka yi a baya ta fuskanci ƙalubale a gasar zakarun Turai, akwai alamun sulhu a Kanada. Abin takaici, Hamilton ya yi ritaya daga tseren saboda matsalar birki, yayin da Rosberg ya samu nasarar zuwa na biyu.'

article_content: In a recent interview with Fox News' Sean Hannity, House Speaker Mike Johnson concurred with the host's assertion that President Biden is experiencing cognitive decline.  Johnson emphasized that this observation wasn't a personal attack but rather a reflection of the realities of aging. He pointed to discernible differences between Biden's past and present public speaking abilities. The Speaker, who has only met President Biden twice, including a brief exchange on Thursday, stressed his respect for the President despite their significant policy disagreements.  Johnson also addressed resurfaced comments he'd made years prior questioning the rights of LGBTQ+ individuals. The Louisiana Republican, known for his evangelical Christian beliefs and past leadership within the Southern Baptist Convention, had previously opposed same-sex marriage.  CNN brought to light columns where Johnson expressed concern over growing acceptance of same-sex marriage, even advocating for the criminalization of gay sex. When questioned by Hannity, Johnson claimed not to recall some of these statements, attributing others to his role as a litigator defending state marriage amendments. However, he affirmed his respect for the Supreme Court's decision in Obergefell v. Hodges, which legalized same-sex marriage, stating the matter is now settled law. He added that while he values the rule of law and loves all people, he differentiates between individuals and their 'lifestyle choices.' Both the White House and Johnson's office have yet to comment on the matter.  Johnson's ability to work with President Biden will soon be tested as they face pressing issues, including impending government funding deadlines.
translated_content: A wata hira da yayi kwanan nan da Sean Hannity na Fox News, Kakakin Majalisar Wakilai Mike Johnson ya amince da ikirarin mai masaukin baki na cewa Shugaba Biden na fuskantar koma baya a tunaninsa. Johnson ya jaddada cewa wannan ba hari bane na kashin kansa, a'a, gaskiyar abin da ke faruwa da tsufa. Ya nuna bambance-bambance tsakanin dabarun magana na Biden a baya da na yanzu. Kakakin, wanda ya hadu da Shugaba Biden sau biyu kacal, ciki har da wata 'yar gajeruwar tattaunawa a ranar Alhamis, ya nanata girmamawarsa ga Shugaban duk da rashin jituwarsu kan manufofi. Johnson ya kuma yi magana kan wasu maganganunsa na baya game da hakokin mutanen LGBTQ+. article_content: 'As the Occupy Wall Street movement entered its 22nd day and expanded to more U.S. cities on Saturday, NYC Mayor Michael Bloomberg criticized many participants. He argued they were targeting the financial sector and harming New York City jobs.  The protests, echoing anti-corporate and anti-government sentiments, reached cities from Cleveland to Las Vegas and Washington to Prescott, Arizona.  Bloomberg stated on WOR radio that union salaries, which bolstered protester numbers earlier that week, originate from taxes paid by the very people being targeted. He acknowledged high unemployment and widespread disaffection but questioned the legitimacy of some protesters' concerns. His remarks coincided with the city's announcement of 700 education worker layoffs due to budget constraints.  This also followed recent census data revealing New York City's poverty rate had climbed to 20.1%, a decade high.  Occupy Wall Street spokesman, Tyler Combelic, countered that Bloomberg wasn't representing all New Yorkers and that the thousands protesting deserved to be heard.  Protesters established a second base at Washington Square Park, about two miles north of Zuccotti Park, their primary rallying point.  A rally, a people's assembly, and an art show took place there Saturday, though the park's curfew prevented overnight stays.  The movement has spread to over a dozen cities, gaining traction with union and other group support. Jim Nichols, an Occupy Atlanta participant, expressed a desire to reclaim the 'American dream,' highlighting social and economic inequality as driving forces.  Even before Bloomberg's comments, the movement elicited strong reactions. President Obama, while defending the financial sector's importance, recognized the protesters' frustration.  Conversely, House Republican Eric Cantor criticized the 'growing mobs,' accusing them of dividing Americans.  U.S. Rep. Charles Rangel, a regular visitor to the New York protests, supported their expression of frustration and constitutional rights. He highlighted their shattered dreams and the economic hardship faced by many, urging more spiritual leaders to join their cause. Rangel dismissed criticisms about the movement's lack of focus, emphasizing the genuine nature of their grievances despite their varied concerns. Combelic emphasized the movement's goal of 'active democracy' and giving everyone a voice. He positioned the protests as a rebuke of both the left and the right, aiming to broaden the discussion and represent the 99% feeling disenfranchised by the recession and political inaction. While mostly peaceful, some New York protests have seen clashes with police, including hundreds of arrests during an unpermitted march on the Brooklyn Bridge.'
translated_content: 'A yayin da zanga-zangar 'Occupy Wall Street' ta shiga ranarta ta 22 tare da fadada zuwa wasu biranen Amurka a ranar Asabar, Magajin Garin New York, Michael Bloomberg, ya soki masu zanga-zangar da dama. Ya yi jayayya cewa suna kai hari ga fannin kudi tare da lalata ayyukan yi na birnin New York.  Zanga-zangar, wadda ta nuna kin amincewa da kamfanoni da gwamnati, ta isa birane daga Cleveland zuwa Las Vegas da Washington zuwa Prescott, Arizona. Bloomberg ya bayyana a gidan rediyon WOR cewa albashin kungiyoyin kwadago, wadanda suka karfafa masu zanga-zangar a farkon makon, sun fito ne daga harajin da wadanda ake hari suke biya. Ya amince da yawan rashin aikin yi da rashin gamsuwa da yawa amma ya yi tambaya game da sahihancin damuwar wasu masu zanga-zangar. Kalaman nasa sun zo daidai da sanarwar da birnin ya bayar na korar ma'aikatan ilimi 700 saboda matsalar kasafin kudi. Wannan kuma ya biyo bayan kididdigar jama'a kwanan nan da ta nuna cewa talauci a birnin New York ya karu zuwa kashi 20.1%, mafi girma cikin fiye da shekaru goma. Kakakin 'Occupy Wall Street', Tyler Combelic, ya mayar da martani cewa Bloomberg bai wakilci dukkan 'yan New York ba kuma cewa dubban masu zanga-zangar sun cancanci a ji su. Masu zanga-zangar sun kafa sansani na biyu a Washington Square Park, kimanin mil biyu arewacin Zuccotti Park, babban wurin taronsu. An yi gangami, taron jama'a, da kuma wani bikin fasaha a can ranar Asabar, duk da cewa dokar hana fita da dare ta hana kwana a wurin. Wannan motsi ya bazu zuwa fiye da birane goma sha biyu, yana samun karbuwa daga kungiyoyin kwadago da sauran kungiyoyi. Jim Nichols, wani mai zanga-zangar 'Occupy Atlanta', ya bayyana sha'awar dawowar 'Mafarkin Amurka,' yana mai jaddada rashin daidaito na zamantakewa da tattalin arziki a matsayin abubuwan da ke haifar da zanga-zangar. Ko kafin kalaman Bloomberg, wannan motsi ya haifar da martani mai karfi. Shugaba Barack Obama, yayin da yake kare mahimmancin fannin kudi, ya amince da bacin rai na masu zanga-zangar. A akasin haka, dan majalisar wakilai na Republican, Eric Cantor, ya soki 'tarin jama'a,' yana zarginsu da raba kan Amurkawa. Dan Majalisar Wakilai ta Amurka, Charles Rangel, wanda ke ziyartar masu zanga-zangar New York akai-akai, ya goyi bayan bayyana bacin ransu da kuma yin amfani da hakkokinsu na tsarin mulki. Ya nuna mafarkinsu da suka ruguje da kuma wahalhalun tattalin arziki da mutane da yawa ke fuskanta, yana mai kira ga shugabannin addinai da su shiga wannan motsi. Rangel ya yi watsi da sukar cewa masu zanga-zangar ba su da wata manufa ta ainihi, yana mai jaddada sahihancin kokensu duk da bambancin damuwarsu. Combelic ya jaddada manufar wannan motsi na 'mulkin dimokuradiyya' da kuma bai wa kowa murya. Ya bayyana zanga-zangar a matsayin suka ga bangarorin hagu da dama, yana nufin fadada tattaunawar da kuma wakiltar kashi 99% na wadanda ke jin an raba su da mulki sakamakon koma bayan tattalin arziki da rashin aikin yi na siyasa. Duk da cewa galibi ana yin zanga-zangar cikin lumana, wasu zanga-zangar a New York sun fuskanci arangama da 'yan sanda, ciki har da kama mutane daruruwa a yayin wata zanga-zangar da ba a ba da izini ba a kan gadar Brooklyn.'
